Original finely hand-painted medieval fantasy battlemap style matching the supplied approved reference images: warm worn timber, stone, iron, linen, leather, delicate crisp contours, rich small-scale texture and earthy muted colors. Even overhead light with tight restrained contact shading. Complete object centered with narrow transparent margin. Actual transparent alpha outside the object. No text, grid, watermark, people, tokens, ruler, background ground patch, glossy plastic or photoreal render. References are STYLE guidance only; create an original item. Subject: small timber pushcart with open display tray of pottery, two thin wheel top edges and handles. Physical footprint ratio 2.5:1.5. North/back is image TOP.
